description: Thursday 12:40, after the presentation: Priya uploads Loom and Field's cutting for approval of Cashew 7214 to the Living room folder as 'Halden Cashew 7214 CFA, lot 26-1144.jpg' and writes nothing. The CFA card in the photo gives dye lot 26-1144 with 9 yd in stock and the next lot about January 18, 2027. Thursday 12:55: Claire uploads IMG_0436.jpg to the same folder, a photo of Maison Verde's wood-finish card that Priya left with her, with the walnut chip circled and 'Arlo in this one, please!' beside it. Thursday 13:20: Claire uploads IMG_0433.jpg, a photo of the note card she wrote after Jessica left: everything can go ahead except the coffee table, which she wants held until she has seen the Pike in walnut. Nothing announces any of the three.
